judgments.explanation: The span identifies the same gene mention and is supported by the source, but it includes the descriptor 'oncogene'. Public gold E30 Theme T37 is the narrower span c-myc at 1476-1481, so this candidate is not exact-creditable under offset-sensitive evaluation.

The source calls antisense strategy a method or strategy, but Negative_regulation E30 has only the c-myc Theme in public gold. The guideline forbids adding an argument merely because a mention occurs in the same sentence, and no explicit event argument supports strategy here.

For the Cell_proliferation event triggered by proliferation, public gold uses cellular (Cell) as Theme. The candidate points to c-myc oncogene, a Gene_or_gene_product, so both participant identity and entity type disagree.

The candidate makes downregulation an argument of the event triggered by strategy. In the source, the antisense strategy is a method associated with the separate downregulation statement; it is not evidence that downregulation is a participant of a Planned_process event. No corresponding public-gold event exists for this candidate.

For the Cell_differentiation event triggered by differentiation, public gold uses cellular (Cell) as Theme. The candidate instead selects c-myc oncogene, a Gene_or_gene_product, so the participant and its type are wrong for this event.

The source explicitly states that the decrease in c-Myc expression enhanced VLB sensitivity, so this is a source-supported causal antecedent for the candidate enhanced-sensitivity event. It is not benchmark credit because public gold has no corresponding event at this occurrence; it should remain review-only.

Public gold E25 Cause is the nested decrease event at 1138-1146. The candidate instead points to the separate enhanced-sensitivity wording at 1167-1175. That wording is source-related, but it is not the typed nested event selected by the gold Cause argument.

Public gold E13 Theme is LoVo-mycANS cells (Cell). VLB is a Simple_chemical in the same sentence, but the guideline does not permit adding it as an argument merely because it occurs in the cytotoxicity statement.

The source explicitly describes induction of the intrinsic pathway. The candidate event is not represented as a participant-bearing event in public gold, so it earns no benchmark credit, but this participant is supported by the source and should not be treated as invented.

The source explicitly says that the apoptotic signaling pathway involves mitochondria. Public gold does not attach mitochondria to the unary Cell_death/pathway-related annotation, so this is source-supported but outside benchmark credit and must remain review-only.

The candidate identifies the same c-Myc mention, and the corrected span 1150-1155 would match public gold T31. The returned span starts one character early and resolves to a leading space plus c-Myc, so it is source-supported but non-creditable because the offset is invalid.

notes: Source-supported equivalents are not benchmark credit and remain review-only.
The public gold comparison is separate from source validity; a source-supported extra is not called an invention.
Occurrence-0 is accepted when it is the first exact occurrence within the supplied event passage.
